English: Palm Patch
A small patch of hand-planted date palms, offering shade and the promise of fruit for the future. The first step in settling the harsh desert.
Irrigation Ditch
A basic trench dug to channel precious water to the palms and tents, increasing the fertility of this oasis outpost.
Shaded Tent
A well-situated, palm-shaded communal tent provides comfort and unity to the clans elders and families.
Water Channel
Stone-lined open channels bring water further into the oasis, transforming the encampment into a verdant hub.
Fruit Grove
Lush groves of date palms, figs, and pomegranates offer abundant harvests and attract more people to the oasis.
Scented Pavilion
A grand tented pavilion, perfumed with flowers and fruit, becomes the heart of the oasis, fostering unity and pride.
Date Palm Hall
A timbered hall raised among the palm groves, serving as a gathering place for feasts, councils, and mediation.
Waterwheel Stand
Waterwheels now raise water from the depths, enabling larger settlements and more reliable harvests year-round.
Fountain Oasis
A true marvel, fountains and pools shimmer beneath the palms, attracting distant traders and increasing the oasiss fame.
Arabic Paradise Garden
A legendary oasis garden of intricate pools, rare blossoms, and cool shade—a symbol of prosperity and unity for all who dwell here.
